Wave Simulator

A simplified lane between your tower (left, blue) and the enemy tower (right, red). Pick a lesson and watch how your choices move the wave. The minions are simplified so each idea shows up in about a minute. Read the wave management guide for the full picture.

Your minions 0Enemy minions 0Wave: The middleNext wave in 0sYour CS 0
You: Last-hit only. You only take the killing blow. The wave stays even.
  1. Both teams send a wave of minions every 30 seconds: 3 melee, 3 casters, and a cannon minion every third wave.
  2. The waves meet in the middle of the lane and fight.
  3. You only last-hit, so you don't change who wins the fight. Both waves stay about the same size.
  4. That's why an even lane keeps meeting near the middle. To move the wave on purpose, you have to change how many minions each side has.

Simplified on purpose: real minions, towers and champions have more rules, but waves push, stack and bounce the same way. Learn the details in Wave Management: Push, Freeze and Crash.
